sentences.text: Issue notice on admission as well as I.A. No.7852/202 payment of process fee by speed post mode.
Process fee be paid within three working days.
Notices are made returnable within a period of six weeks.

In view of the submission made by counsel for appellants, it is directed that subject to deposit of Rs.25.000/- within a period of one month from today by each of appellant, the recovery of the penalty amount shall remain stayed.

List this case on 05.03.2026 for final hearing at motion stage or else for confirmation of stay.
